about_the_game:
Claw your way to glory in this fast-paced 2D platformer-shooter adventure!

Play as a fearless feline on a mission through five action-packed worlds, each teeming with enemies, hazards, and hidden treasures. Jump, slide, and blast your way through vibrant retro-style levels, collecting coins and rare gems to upgrade your abilities and become more powerful.

With tight controls, challenging platforming, and explosive combat, every level is a test of skill and reflexes. Upgrade your cat's powers—from a basic pistol to a fully automatic weapon, double jumps and bubble shield — as you prepare to face off against world bosses.

Whether you're a casual cat lover or a hardcore arcade veteran, this game delivers the perfect mix of challenge, charm, and chaos.

Think you're done? Think again. Beat all five worlds and unlock a hidden vault of bonus levels and arcade-style minigames!

Challenge your reflexes and rack up high scores in quirky side challenges like Coconut Catch, where timing is everything, or Ice Climb, a vertical sprint through slippery chaos.

Each minigame offers a fresh twist on the core mechanics, with online leaderboards so you can compete with friends and claw your way to the top. These bite-sized challenges are the perfect way to test your skills and keep the fun going long after the final boss is defeated.
